# AI Router: Quick Start

1. [Create an AI router](#create-ai-router).
2. Optional: [set an API key limit](#set-api-key-limit).
3. [Check AI router operation](#check-ai-router-operation).

## 1. Create an AI router \{#create-ai-router}

1. Make sure that after completing [registration](/account/registration.mdx) you have [topped up your balance](https://docs.selectel.ru/balance-and-payments/manage/top-up-balance/) with a minimum amount of 200 ₽. This is required to access the service. The funds will remain on your balance.
2. In the [control panel](https://my.selectel.ru/ml/default/ai-router), in the top menu, click **Products** and select **AI Router**.
3. In the **AI Router** section, click **Create AI router**.
4. Enter the AI router name.
5. Optional: enter a description.
6. Enter the key name.
7. Click **Create**. The API key can only be viewed once after creation — copy and save it.

## 2. Optional: set a limit on the API key \{#set-api-key-limit}

1. In the [control panel](https://my.selectel.ru/ml/default/ai-router), in the top menu, click **Products** and select **AI Router**.
2. In the **AI Router** section, open the AI router page → the **Keys and limits** tab.
3. In the <MoreVerticalIcon /> menu of the key, select **Change limit**.
4. Enter the new limit value in rubles.
5. Click <CheckIcon />.

## 3. Check AI router operation \{#check-ai-router-operation}

1. Open the CLI.
2. Send a test request:

   ```shell
   export API_KEY="<api_key>"
   curl -X POST --http2 \
   'https://api.selectel.ru/aig/v1/chat/completions' \
   --header "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
   --data '{
       "model": "moonshotai/kimi-k2.6",
       "stream": false,
       "reasoning": {
       "effort": "low"
       },
       "messages": [
       {
           "role": "user",
           "content": "Tell me about Selectel"
       }
       ]
   }'
   ```

   Specify `<api_key>` — the API key you saved when [creating the AI router in step 1](#create-ai-router).

In this mode, the server processes the request and returns the result to the client within a single HTTP connection. The connection with the client is held open until the response is fully generated. On the client side, you can [send synchronous](#send-sync-request) and [asynchronous requests](#send-async-request). Various [API types](#api-types) are available for working with models, depending on the task and model category. ## API types \{#api-types} API types define the request data structure and response format. Available APIs depend on the model deployed in the inference service. Learn more about API types in their official documentation.
API typeDescriptionModel category
[Completions API](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/completions)Text generation based on a single prompt — without support for dialog or message historyText generation models, multimodal models
[Chat API](https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/chat)Text generation in dialog mode — taking into account roles and message historyText generation models, multimodal models
[Embeddings API](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/embeddings) Converting text into numerical vectors — embeddings. Used for semantic search across data, for example, in vector databases Embedding generation models
[Rerank API](https://jina.ai/reranker/) Evaluating relevance and sorting texts according to how well they match a query. Used to improve response quality when using RAG Text ranking models
[Transcriptions API](https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/audio/subresources/transcriptions/methods/create)Converting an audio file to textSpeech recognition models

import Formbricks from '@theme/MDXComponents/Formbricks';

# Token Factory: Quickstart

1. [Submit a testing request](#create-test-request).
2. [Create an API key](#create-api-key).
3. [Send a test request to the model](#send-request).

## 1. Submit a testing request \{#create-test-request}

The product is in private preview. To get access to testing the product, submit a request to technical support.

1. In the [control panel](https://my.selectel.ru/ml/default/token-factory), in the top menu, click **Products** and select **Token Factory**.
2. In the **Token Factory** section, click **Create API key**.
3. Optional: in the **Comment** field, enter the desired model, contact details, and testing requirements.
4. Click **Submit request**. A ticket with a request for Token Factory testing will be generated automatically.
5. Wait for a response from a Selectel specialist in the ticket.

## 2. Create an API key \{#create-api-key}

1. [Top up your balance](/balance-and-payments/manage/top-up-balance.mdx).
2. In the [control panel](https://my.selectel.ru/ml/default/token-factory), in the top menu, click **Products** and select **Token Factory**.
3. In the **Token Factory** section, click **Create API key**.
4. Enter a key name or click **Generate**.
5. Select the key validity period.
6. Click **Create**. The API key can only be viewed once after creation — copy and save it.

## 3. Send a test request to the model \{#send-request}

1. Open the CLI.
2. Send a test request:

   ```bash
   curl https://preview.tf.selcloud.ru/v1/chat/completions \
   -H "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   -d '{
       "model": "<model_id>",
       "messages": [
       {
           "role": "developer",
           "content": "You are a helpful assistant."
       },
       {
           "role": "user",
           "content": "Hello!"
       }
       ]
   }'
   ```

   Specify:

   * `<api_key>` — the API key that you [created in step 1](#create-api-key).

   * `<model_id>` — model ID, can be copied in the [control panel](https://my.selectel.ru/ml/default/token-factory): in the top menu, click **Products** → **Token Factory** → the **Model Catalog** tab → on the model card, click <CopyIcon /> next to the model name.
